title: Internet & WWW: Foundations
welcome_lead: The internet is the wires. The web is the pages. They are not the same!
meta_desc: KS3 internet basics: difference from web, ISPs, URLs.
final_note: Understand the layers and the internet stops being mysterious.

concepts.def: Global network connecting billions of devices.
Web pages and links that run on the internet.
The address of a web page.
Internet Service Provider — your connection seller.
App used to view web pages.
Clickable link to another page or file.

walkthroughs.body_html: The internet is the cables, routers and Wi-Fi. The web is one service on top — websites you visit. Email, video calls and games are other services.
A URL has three parts: protocol://domain/path. Example: https://bbc.co.uk/news. The protocol says how, the domain says where.
An ISP sells you a connection. They give you an IP address and route your traffic to and from the wider internet.
